recipes.title: Pasta Carbonara
recipes.description: A simple Italian pasta recipe with eggs, cheese and bacon.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente. Fry the bacon until crispy. Mix eggs and Parmesan in a bowl. Combine everything together while the pasta is still hot and season with black pepper.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.description: Soft homemade pancakes, perfect for breakfast.
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter. Heat a pan with a little butter and cook the pancakes until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Fresh salad with tomatoes, cucumber, olives and feta cheese.
recipes.instructions: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Add olives and feta cheese, then drizzle with olive oil and mix gently.

recipes.title: Lasagna
recipes.description: Classic Italian lasagna with layers of pasta, meat sauce and cheese.
recipes.instructions: Prepare the meat sauce and layer it with lasagna sheets and cheese. Bake in the oven until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: Rich and moist chocolate cake with chocolate frosting.
recipes.instructions: Prepare the cake batter and bake until fully cooked. Let it cool before covering it with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing, chicken, croutons and Parmesan cheese.
recipes.instructions: Cook and slice the chicken. Toss the lettuce with Caesar dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
recipes.description: Creamy pasta with grilled chicken and Parmesan Alfredo sauce.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta and grill the chicken. Prepare the Alfredo sauce with cream, garlic and Parmesan cheese. Combine everything together and serve warm.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Classic pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella and fresh basil.
recipes.instructions: Spread tomato sauce over the dough and add mozzarella cheese. Bake until golden, then top with fresh basil and olive oil.

recipes.title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
recipes.description: Refreshing smoothie bowl with berries, banana and crunchy toppings.
recipes.instructions: Blend the berries, banana and yogurt until smooth. Pour into a bowl and top with granola, fresh fruit and honey.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Mexican-style tacos filled with seasoned beef, vegetables and cheese.
recipes.instructions: Cook the ground beef with taco seasoning. Fill the taco shells with beef, lettuce, tomatoes and cheese before serving.

recipes.title: Sushi Rolls
recipes.description: Fresh homemade sushi rolls with rice, salmon and avocado.
recipes.instructions: Prepare the sushi rice and spread it over the nori sheets. Add the fillings and roll tightly before slicing into pieces.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger
recipes.description: Juicy homemade cheeseburger with crispy fries.
recipes.instructions: Shape and cook the beef patties until browned. Add cheese on top, then assemble the burgers with fresh vegetables and buns.
